title: FormLogic Desktop event envelope
description: Every event flowing plugin -> FormLogic Desktop -> FormLogic Web uses this envelope. Canonical copy: formlogic-app/docs/contracts/. Consumers must ignore unknown OPTIONAL fields from newer minor revisions, but producers must not add fields without bumping schemaVersion.

correlationId.description: Call/session/run id shared by all events of one logical interaction.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable unique key for THIS event occurrence, e.g. "aokie:call_abc:incoming:v1". Consumers dedupe on it.

data.description: Event-specific payload. May be any JSON value; PII must already be minimised by the producer.
